divergences.old: openshift resource-usage --csv printing raw CSV to stdout instead of the envelope
divergences.toil: --csv writes the CSV to a file in the workspace named with --out <file>, never overwriting, and data returns the saved absolute path. Nothing but the envelope goes to stdout
divergences.why: Every command writes exactly one envelope; CSV goes to a file only (decision 4 on #68).
Where the CSV goes has to be named, since it no longer goes to stdout (decision 4 on #68).
